blocks.text: Documents the two-part history (Part 1 = config + self-checks, Part 2 = backend connection) and the optional preview proxy (W7.4). The logging.basicConfig at module level applies a fixed format for all loggers within this process.
blocks.title: Module header and logging setup

blocks.text: Three probes: a path inside the root that must be accepted, a sibling of the root that must be rejected, and a classic '../..' traversal from inside the root that must also be rejected. Each failure is logged clearly before raising, so the person at the terminal sees what went wrong.
blocks.title: Containment self-check

blocks.text: Returns None immediately when config.preview is None. Otherwise creates a PreviewProxy and calls start(); an OSError (port in use) is caught, logged with actionable guidance, and returns None so the main loop can continue without the proxy.
blocks.title: Preview proxy startup

blocks.text: Loads config, runs _self_check, logs the startup banner, registers signal handlers that set a stop_event, starts the preview proxy, then awaits connection.run_forever(config, stop_event). The finally block stops the proxy on clean exit or error. Returns 0 on success, 1 on config/self-check failure.
blocks.title: Main async body

blocks.text: main() is the setuptools/pip entry-point target; it calls asyncio.run(_amain()) and the __main__ block passes its return value to sys.exit.
blocks.title: Synchronous entry point

gotchas: If _self_check raises, the daemon exits with code 1 before ever opening a network connection
signal.signal is used rather than loop.add_signal_handler for Windows compatibility
Preview proxy failure is non-fatal — the daemon logs the error and continues
how_it_works: _self_check runs three containment probes against the real configured root: an inside path (must pass), an outside path (must be rejected), and a '../..' traversal (must be rejected) — startup is aborted if any check fails
_start_preview_proxy starts a PreviewProxy when MINIME_PREVIEW_TARGET is configured; a bind failure is logged and the daemon continues without it
_amain loads config, runs _self_check, registers SIGINT/SIGTERM handlers that set an asyncio.Event, then runs connection.run_forever(config, stop_event) until the event is set
SIGINT/SIGTERM are registered with signal.signal (not loop.add_signal_handler) so the same code works on Windows and Unix
inputs: daemon/.env config file read by daemon.config.load_config
outputs: exit code (0 on clean shutdown, 1 on config or self-check failure)
purpose: Loads daemon configuration, proves that path containment works against the real configured root (not just test fixtures), and then connects outward to the backend via daemon/connection.py's run_forever(). Optionally starts a preview reverse proxy alongside the WebSocket connection. Handles SIGINT/SIGTERM for clean shutdown on both Windows and Unix.
side_effects: outbound WebSocket connection to MINIME_BACKEND_WS_URL via connection.run_forever
optional TCP port binding for the preview proxy
summary: Entry point for the MiniMe local daemon: loads config, runs containment self-checks, then maintains a WebSocket connection to the backend.

params.desc: loaded DaemonConfig; config.allowed_root is the root Path under test
params.name: config

raises: PathGuardError if inside-root path is rejected or if outside/traversal path is accepted
side_effects: logs pass/fail for each probe to the minime_daemon logger
symbols.summary: Runs three path-containment probes against the real configured root; raises PathGuardError and aborts startup if any probe produces the wrong result.

params.desc: loaded DaemonConfig; config.preview carries preview target and port or is None
params.name: config

symbols.returns: PreviewProxy instance on success, None otherwise
side_effects: binds a TCP port for the preview proxy on success
symbols.summary: Starts the preview reverse proxy when configured; returns None and logs a warning if the port is unavailable or preview is not configured.

symbols.returns: int — 0 on clean stop, 1 on config error or self-check failure
side_effects: logs startup banner and shutdown message
symbols.summary: Async main function: loads config, self-checks, registers shutdown signals, starts preview proxy, then runs the backend connection loop until a stop signal is received.
